task.description:
Implement the approved §2.5 amendment (empty-declared_fields exemption) in lib/letflow/definitions/semantic_validation.ex. Read the amendment in full (§2.5.1 through §2.5.4.1) in lib/letflow/design/req372-semantic-decision-rule-validation.md first. You are on branch feature/WF02-REQ372-20260921 -- verify with git branch --show-current, pull if needed.

Implement: Letflow.Definitions.SemanticValidation.validate/2 must return %{valid: true, violations: []} unconditionally when the declared_fields map passed in is empty (%{}) -- add this guard inside validate/2 itself (per §2.5.3), before any edge/AST walk, so it applies uniformly to both call sites (activate/2 and validate_definition_graph/2) with no per-caller special-casing. Update the moduledoc to state this behavior explicitly (matching what the amendment's §2.5.1/§2.5.2 reasoning says) alongside the existing type-pair table and HUMAN_TASK-out-of-scope statement.

Do NOT touch the three test files yet -- those are TEST-DESIGNER's job in the next step (step-03f), per the amendment's own §2.5.4.1 guidance on how each must be revised. Your job here is implementation only.

Run mix compile --warnings-as-errors (must exit 0) and mix format --check-formatted (run mix format first if needed). Do not run the full test suite here -- that happens formally at TEST-RUNNER's step once TEST-DESIGNER has revised the three conflicting tests; running it now would show the same 3 new failures TEST-DESIGNER is about to fix, which is expected and not a signal to second-guess this implementation.

Claim the handoff (status IN_PROGRESS), implement, verify compile/format, then set status COMPLETED with a genuine first-hand result. next_action on PASS: "Route to SECURITY-REVIEWER for amendment regate". Do not touch created_at/started_at. Commit the changed file plus the updated handoff, push to origin/feature/WF02-REQ372-20260921. Never push to main, never touch web/.
